Chapter 686 - 686 System Upgrade; Congratulations

Chapter 686 - 686 System Upgrade; Congratulations

686 System Upgrade; Congratulations

Lin Fan could sense a palpitating aura from the ancient altar.

He knew that if he did not stop it, he might be in danger.

Stepping out, Lin Fan vanished from where he stood.

The bug general in front of him wanted to attack but was stopped by Qing Song.

At this moment, Lin Fan had already arrived in front of the altar. Just as he was about to attack the altar, two more bug generals appeared in front of him.

The two generals waved their claws and shot out strong gales toward Lin Fan.

Lin Fan had no choice but to dodge.

The two generals did not give up and continued to chase. They kept colliding in the air, forming light shadows.

At this moment, the spirit crystals around the altar shone brighter and brighter, and the circles of spell formations became more complicated and mysterious.

The door finally opened a small crack.

In an instant, an inky aura rushed out from the gap of the door. The violent wind blew everyone’s clothes.

A shadow of a pitch-black claw slowly appeared on the altar.

The terrifying baleful aura was like thunder, jumping around the claw phantom.

After a while, another shadow of a claw floated above the altar.

Then, two legs, a body, and a head appeared…

Finally, a pitch-black hundred-meter-tall giant bug with strange patterns all over its body appeared.

The Bug Queen had descended!

The dense baleful aura was so strong that even breathing in it would cause one to feel a stinging pain.

A loud cry shook the entire abyss.

All Chaos Locusts, even the generals who were still fighting Qing Song and the others, prostrated on the ground to express their respect for the Bug Queen.

Qing Song, Ma Zheng, and Feng Yue turned pale.

“We’re done for!”

“The Bug Queen has descended!”

“What should we do now?”

…

At this moment, the hundred-meter-tall Bug Queen opened her scarlet eyes that were like the cold moon.

The entire abyss instantly turned into a blood-red color, making one’s hair stand on end.

The space was frozen, making it impossible to even move one’s eyelids.

Looking at those eyes, Lin Fan’s heart tightened.

Unrivaled!

Lin Fan had a very clear feeling in his heart. If the other party made a move, he would instantly turn into dust.

He could not let her make the first move!

Lin Fan circulated the power of time with all his might and surrounded the Bug Queen with it.

Instantly, the Bug Queen’s tall body that had just condensed began to become illusory.

She could not help but look at Lin Fan with a pair of cold eyes.

“How dare you?!”

Her voice was like thunder, causing people’s heads to buzz.

A vast aura turned into thousands of sharp blades that shot toward Lin Fan.

Another wave of time power appeared, and the sharp blade that was rushing over disappeared like dust.

Following that, Lin Fan increased the power of time once more.

The Bug Queen’s claws disappeared, and so did her limbs and torso…

Gradually, the huge body disappeared without a trace.

Only a cold voice was left, echoing in the abyss.

“Human, I will remember you!”

Finally, the door closed and the talisman disappeared.

Peace returned.

The Chaos Locusts were all confused.

Why had their queen disappeared?

As for Lin Fan, he did not give them any chance to react.

He needed to take advantage of this situation to save his life!

Lin Fan brandished the Star Meteorite Sword with all his might. Sword energy surged out like a cold wind.

The three-headed bug general and the endless Chaos Locusts were all sliced into pieces.

Feng Yue, Ma Zheng, and Qing Song also reacted quickly and attacked the generals together.

Blood flowed, energy surged, and strong winds howled.

A moment later, all the Chaos Locusts were killed.

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! System upgrade successful!]

System upgrade?

Lin Fan was stunned.

Before he could come back to his senses, a crisp notification sounded in his mind again.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve completed the hidden mission to disrupt the arrival of the Bug Queen. Reward: 100,000 experience points.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve reached Star Traveller Level 2.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve reached Star Traveller Level 3.]

Instantly, Lin Fan’s body felt warm.

A majestic energy rippled in his limbs and bones.

It really was the system!

Then, Lin Fan willed it, and a clear interface appeared in his mind.

[Host: Lin Fan]

[Cultivation: Star Traveller Level 3 (10,000/100,000)]

[Skill: Sword 81]

[Equipment: Star Meteorite Sword]

[Laws: Time (elementary), Space (elementary), Metal (elementary), Wood (elementary), Water (elementary), Fire (elementary), Earth (elementary)]

[Character Relationship:

[Lin Tao: Father. Favorability: Ten stars]

[Dai Weixue: Mom. favorability: Ten stars.]

Lin Xiaoyao: Sister. Favorability: Ten stars;

Xia Xue: Dao companion. Favorability: Ten stars]

[Xia Bing: Dao companion. Favorability: Ten stars…]

He had really leveled up!

It was a completely different panel.

Back then, when Lin Fan was still a Chaos Dragon God, he had come across a gemstone by chance. He had discovered that there was an extremely peculiar structure within it.

After some simple refinement, he created the red packet and the check-in system.

How did it level up now?

Furthermore, he saw that the time, space, and five-element laws he had mastered were all at the elementary level?

The system’s grade had increased!

At this moment, Ma Zheng, Feng Yue, and Qing Song walked over.

“S-Senior Lin.”

“Thank you, Senior Lin.”

“Thank you, Senior Lin.”

The three of them subconsciously addressed Lin Fan as senior.

This was normal.

The strength that Lin Fan had displayed earlier was simply too mystical.

He drove away the descending insect emperor and instantly killed thousands of Chaos locusts.

“No need to be so polite,” Lin Fan said.

Then, he looked at the spirit crystals around the altar and said, “Let’s split these things.”

Ma Zheng hurriedly said, “These Chaos Locusts were killed by you, and the Bug Queen was also driven away by you… Everything should belong to you.”

“That’s right,” Feng Yue added.

“Yes, yes!” Qing Song said.

In their hearts, they thought that an expert like Lin Fan probably would not be interested in such things.

However, they did not dare to take the things that belonged to Lin Fan.

Lin Fan replied, “Alright.”

With a wave of his hand, all the spirit crystals disappeared into the internal space.

“Let’s go out,” Lin Fan said.

“Yes, sir!” Qing Song, Ma Zheng, and Feng Yue said in unison.

…

Just as they were walking out of the abyss, or rather, just as Lin Fan’s system had successfully leveled up…

Outside Qing Planet, the wind and clouds surged, and multicolored light shone brightly.

These rays of light continuously gathered and twisted. In the end, they actually formed four words that were as bright as the sun—’Congratulations!’

This change immediately attracted everyone’s attention and discussion.

“What is this?”

“Is it the latest high-tech?”

“But it doesn’t seem like it.”

“There seems to be a very strong energy fluctuation.”

…
